algorithm.name: v1
algorithm.path_order: LC_ALL=C byte order of the UTF-8 relative path
algorithm.case_body: sha256 of the exact TypeScript test(...)/it(...) CallExpression text from the test token through the matching ')', excluding the trailing semicolon
algorithm.file_hash: sha256 of the raw file bytes from an LF checkout
algorithm.line_count: str::lines() count: LF separators, a trailing LF does not add a line
algorithm.tree: regular files only (symlinks rejected); sorted relative_path_utf8 + NUL + raw_bytes + NUL; lowercase SHA-256
